name: Musée Ecologique du Millénaire
description: The Millennium Ecological Museum, located in Yaoundé, Cameroon, was founded by ethnobotanist and professor Bernard-Aloys Nkongmeneck. Inaugurated in January 2016 as the first natural history museum in Central Africa, it houses more than 24,000 specimens of plants, animals, and rocks.
bonASavoir: The Millennium Ecological Museum (located in Ntouessong near Soa/Yaoundé) does not publish a fixed official entrance fee online, as it is a private nature history initiative. Admission fees generally depend on guided tours or hikes organized on-site.
